checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the tail checkpoint is untestable due to cropping. All visible facial and body checkpoints were marked present, which aligns with the visual evidence of a white-faced capuchin. The Router was not too lenient; the features are distinct and match the taxonomy.
artifact_review: The Router noted minor texture anomalies (severity 1.5) and background distortion (severity 1.0). However, the animal_pose_auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk level (41% low-confidence keypoints), specifically in the hind limbs and lower torso. While the Reflector instructions caution against over-interpreting low confidence in AI images due to domain shift, the concentration of low confidence in the lower body (hips, knees, ankles) combined with the cropped nature of the image suggests potential structural ambiguity or 'melting' where the monkey merges with the background/foliage. The topology mask shows a clean silhouette, but the internal structure of the lower body is suspect. I will adjust the artifact score slightly lower than the formula reference to account for this structural uncertainty, though it is not catastrophic.
alignment_reasoning: The fine_grained_classifier strongly confirms the class (Top-1 logit 7.74 vs Top-2 6.2). All visible taxonomic features (cap, face color, nose shape) are present and correct. The image is a high-fidelity representation of Cebus capucinus.
